summary: Examples of urlsplit returning all components as a dict, and just hostname, query or path.
questions: What does urlsplit return for a full URL?
How do I get the path of a URL?
How do I get the port from a URL?

answer_card.title: urlsplit examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
parts: '{{ "http://user:password@www.acme.com:9000/dir/index.html?query=term#fragment" | urlsplit }}'
# => {fragment: fragment, hostname: www.acme.com, netloc: user:password@www.acme.com:9000,
#     password: password, path: /dir/index.html, port: 9000, query: query=term,
#     scheme: http, username: user}

hostname: '{{ url | urlsplit("hostname") }}'   # www.acme.com
query: '{{ url | urlsplit("query") }}'         # query=term
path: '{{ url | urlsplit("path") }}'           # /dir/index.html
```
